caption: Our one-page test PDF opened in Foxit PDF Editor Cloud in the browser within seconds, with no install. Several Home tools, Edit Text among them, carry an orange paid mark. The avatar is hidden.
Adding a comment worked on the free web editor: the note Test note: check the total. saved with Auto Save on. The avatar and the note author are hidden.
The Edit tab is mostly paid: Edit Text, Edit Object, Search & Replace, Add Text and Add Image all carry the orange mark. The avatar and the note author are hidden.
Clicking Edit Text opened a trial offer for Foxit PDF Editor+ at $159.99 a year instead of the editor. We clicked neither Free Trial nor Buy Now. The avatar is hidden.
After the test the account showed No subscriptions, so the free web editor and the comment cost nothing. The profile block and avatar are hidden.
